extras: Hooks into internal APIs and may break compatibility with Obsidian updates.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that hides files matched by the core Excluded files setting from the built-in Quick Switcher and editor link suggestions.
problem: Core Obsidian features like Quick Switcher and link suggestions include files that the user has explicitly marked as excluded.
summary: Hides files marked as excluded by Obsidian's core settings from the Quick Switcher and link suggestion lists.
